notes: Lower of self (13) and reviewer (12): hook 1: a clear date and a strong full-bleed Kargil image, but the cover's stake for a national reader is only 'polls on 4 Dec'. The tension (first councils in all eight districts, winter polls amid a shutdown) is on slide 04, not the cover. send 1: an obvious forward for Ladakhi voters, candidates and their families (nominations close 17 Nov), a weaker reason for most of the national audience.
